facts.business: Indian Toners & Developers Ltd manufactures and sells compatible toner powder, with 16% of revenue from exports and the rest from domestic sales.
key_risks: Adverse geopolitical conditions in key export markets disrupting trade and reducing order flows
facts.related_party_note: The Audit Committee reviews related party transactions i.e., transactions of the Company of material nature, with promoters or management their subsidiaries or relatives etc. that may have potential conflict with the interests of Company at large and are at arm's length.
